reviewer_role: person or group that did not develop or package benchmark v1
reviewer_tasks: start from the released artifact on a supported platform
run the quickstart and retain its CON-8 record with environment, commands, elapsed and resource data, failures, and documentation gaps
build and submit one registered bundle and retain the evaluator receipt
self_attestation: forbidden: owner self-review, synthetic signatures, and admin merges do not satisfy this gate
status: open: no reviewer engaged; nothing here is a review
title: External user completes the clean-clone cell and a registered submission
what_the_maintainer_may_do: answer documented questions; never edit the reviewer's environment, record, or result in place
what_the_reviewer_signs: the machine-readable record named in BMK-21 including submission and evaluator receipt
